observations: Photo 0 shows a white chest freezer with the brand name 'SKYRUN' visible on the front left side.
The freezer has a blue sticker with 'SKYRUN' and various icons, possibly indicating features or certifications.
The freezer is placed on a wooden platform over a tiled floor with some debris around.
Photo 1 shows the freezer with the lid open, revealing the interior. The lid has a textured surface with a small handle in the center.
The front panel of the freezer in photo 1 shows the same 'SKYRUN' branding and a power switch on the lower right.
Photo 2 shows the interior of the freezer with several plastic bottles and a small container inside, indicating it is being used for storage.
The interior walls appear to have some frost or ice buildup, especially on the right side and bottom.
The seller claims the freezer is 'Working perfectly buy and enjoy'.

claims.evidence: No photo shows the freezer in operation or any indicator of power usage. The presence of frost and stored items suggests use, but does not confirm current functionality.

risks.risk: Freezer may not be cooling properly or may be defrosting due to malfunction
risks.proof: A video clip showing the freezer running with the compressor active, or a photo of the temperature display if available, or a photo of the freezer with the lid closed and no frost buildup after 24 hours of operation.

risks.risk: Interior damage or mold due to frost buildup
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the interior walls and floor, especially the frosty areas, to check for mold, cracks, or damage.

risks.risk: Power switch or electrical component failure
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the power switch and cord, and ideally a photo of the plug being inserted into a socket with the switch turned on.

proof_requests: Video clip of the freezer running with the compressor active.
Close-up photo of the interior walls and floor to check for mold or damage.
Close-up photo of the power switch and cord, and a photo of the plug in a socket with the switch on.
response.reason: The freezer is identifiable as a SKYRUN chest freezer, but the claim of 'working perfectly' cannot be verified from the photos alone. There are hidden risks related to functionality and interior condition that must be proven before pricing can be determined.
